index idx_agent_delegation_edges_receiver: CREATE INDEX idx_agent_delegation_edges_receiver ON agent_delegation_edges (receiver_agent_id)
table agent_delegation_edges: CREATE TABLE "agent_delegation_edges" ( caller_agent_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "agent_owners"(principal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, receiver_agent_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "agent_owners"(principal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, outbound_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (outbound_enabled IN (0, 1)), inbound_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (inbound_enabled IN (0, 1)), generation TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (caller_agent_id, receiver_agent_id), CHECK (caller_agent_id <> receiver_agent_id) ) STRICT
